title: Post-marketing Surveillance on Long Term Use of Ofev Capsules in Systemic Scleroderma Associated Interstitial Lung Disease (SSc-ILD) in Japan
off: Post-marketing Surveillance on Long Term Use of Ofev Capsules in Systemic Scleroderma Associated Interstitial Lung Disease (SSc-ILD) in Japan
summary: The primary objective is to confirm the incidence of adverse drug reactions (focus on gastrointestinal symptoms including diarrhoea and nausea) to Ofev Capsules seen in clinical trials with real world data generated in patients with SSc-ILD.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients in Japan with SSc-ILD who are prescribed with Ofev Capsules and have never been treated with Ofev Capsules before enrolment will be included.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None.
